data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day as a standard action, you can summon a pair of hound archons. The hound archons follow your commands perfectly for %1 minutes before vanishing back to their home in Heaven. The hound archons don't follow commands that would violate their lawful good alignment. Such commands will not only earn refusal and scorn from the hound archons, but could cause them to attack you if the command is particularly egregious.|TL
